files.role: bounded one-shot private StandardMaterial3D preparation pool
actual compact, lifecycle, malformed input and load-cost suite
API, evidence, load-only cost and integration limits

api.configure: exact ordered StandardMaterial3D sources + generation/revision; returns opaque preparation_token
api.prewarm_step: max_count must equal 1; creates at most one independent private Resource
api.receipt: complete source/private identity and signature validation
api.take_prepared: one-shot complete validation and ownership transfer requiring token/generation/revision
api.reset: strictly newer generation and new opaque token
api.dispose: disconnects owned watchers; transferred Resources remain caller-owned

performance_us.qualification: isolated headless load-only CPU; final step validates 72 source plus 72 private signatures; max_count=1 bounds allocations only; no event, streaming, GPU, FPS, full-scene or adoption claim

limits: Nested non-null Resources are rejected; no deep nested Resource parity claim
Prepared storage does not authenticate callback order, opacity, burn values, HP, authority, binding or launch
Receipt and transfer each cost about 47-50 ms and must not run in an event frame
This component does not solve the rejected event-time material path
